deadline.value: January 5 application deadline for Fall semester.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is January 5th for each Fall semester.

gre_general.value: Department does not require GRE scores for admission.
gre_general.quote: The department does not require GRE scores for admission. It is not a necessary expense, nor will it necessarily help your application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Earth Sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Important to contact potential advisor(s) in advance before deadline closes.

funding.value: USC Earth Sciences offers a 5-year, fully funded PhD program including tuition and yearly stipend.
funding.quote: USC Earth Sciences offers a 5-year, fully funded Ph.D. program. Support includes tuition and a yearly stipend (the current 26-27 rate is $47,936) funded by a combination of research assistantship (RA), teaching assistantship (TA), and, in some cases, fellowships.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. university or equivalent required.
entry_route.quote: You hold a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited university in the United States or the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from an officially recognized university in another qualifying Anglophone country where English is both the only official language and the language of instruction.
